8297EB28.name: Swimming
8297EB28.desc: Virtual-call thunk: loads the vtable pointer from the object in r3, reads slot 23 (byte offset 92), and tail-calls it. Reached when the child character swims.
8297EB28.trigger: Swim as the child. (Name already fixed by the user; preserved verbatim.)

8297EB48.name: Story_FirstChildCombat
8297EB48.desc: Virtual-call thunk: object in r3 -> vtable slot 25 (offset 100) -> bctr. Triggers the first combat encounter of the childhood (Albion) prologue.
8297EB48.trigger: The first fight as the child in the opening Albion sequence.

8274B788.name: Story_SisterAfterFirstFight
8274B788.role: interacting with sister after first fight (vtable slot 37)
8274B788.desc: Virtual-call thunk: object in r3 -> vtable slot 37 (offset 148) -> bctr. Fires the interaction with the player's sister immediately after the first childhood fight.
8274B788.trigger: Talk to your sister right after the first childhood battle.

8274B738.name: Story_EnterWarehouseAsChild
8274B738.role: entering the warehouse as child (vtable slot 38)
8274B738.desc: Virtual-call thunk: object in r3 -> vtable slot 38 (offset 152) -> bctr. Triggers the scripted beat for entering the warehouse during the childhood prologue.
8274B738.trigger: Walk into the warehouse as the child in the Albion prologue.

82DDC4D8.name: Story_ShootBeetleInWarehouse
82DDC4D8.role: shooting the Beetle in the warehouse (vtable slot 9, arg-shuffled)
82DDC4D8.desc: Variant virtual-call thunk: takes an object in r4 (moves it to r3), reads vtable[0] then slot 9 (offset 36) of the nested object, and tail-calls it with a shifted argument set (r4<-r5). Fires the shooting interaction on the Beetle target in the warehouse.
82DDC4D8.trigger: Shoot the Beetle (target) in the warehouse as the child.

82988F38.name: Story_TalkToCameraMan
82988F38.role: talking to the camera man, child scene (vtable slot 17)
82988F38.desc: Virtual-call thunk: object in r3 -> vtable slot 17 (offset 68) -> bctr. Triggers the conversation with the camera man in the childhood scene.
82988F38.trigger: Talk to the camera man during the child (Albion) scene.

82988F48.name: Story_LookLittleSparrow
82988F48.desc: Virtual-call thunk: object in r3 -> vtable slot 45 (offset 180) -> bctr. Fires after the new-game intro, tied to the 'look, little sparrow' moment gated on the LT button.
82988F48.trigger: After the new-game intro video, at the 'look, little sparrow' LT prompt.

82988EC8.name: Story_AfterNewGameVideo
82988EC8.desc: Virtual-call thunk: object in r3 -> vtable slot 19 (offset 76) -> bctr. Triggers the beat immediately after the new-game intro video finishes.
82988EC8.trigger: Right after the new-game intro video plays.

823A1810.name: Story_JobSignBlacksmith
823A1810.role: interacting with the blacksmith job sign
823A1810.desc: Loads a global object pointer (data at ~0x833xxxxx built from lis r11,-31927; lwz r3,27596(r11)), forwards the incoming r3 as r4, then tail-calls sub_82297F88. Handles the interaction with the job/quest sign for the blacksmith.
823A1810.trigger: Interact with the job sign (blacksmith) in the town.

82988EE8.name: Skill_AimRangeWeapon
82988EE8.role: aiming a range weapon (skill), vtable slot 23 on r4
82988EE8.desc: Virtual-call thunk reading the object from r4 (not r3): vtable slot 23 (offset 92) -> bctr. Same slot as Swimming but dispatched on a different register, used when aiming a ranged weapon (skill).
82988EE8.trigger: Aim a ranged weapon / use the aiming skill.

8274B768.name: Story_TatterSpireGetMoving
8274B768.desc: Virtual-call thunk: object in r3 -> vtable slot 20 (offset 80) -> bctr. Fires when arriving at the Tatter Spire and the man says 'Get Moving'.
8274B768.trigger: Arrive at the Tatter Spire when the man says 'Get Moving'.

82988ED8.name: LoadingScreen_Virtual43
82988ED8.desc: Virtual-call thunk: object in r3 -> vtable slot 43 (offset 172) -> bctr. Part of the loading-screen function group used when starting a new game.
82988ED8.trigger: Loading screen when starting a new game (internal dispatch).

82988F28.name: LoadingScreen_Virtual48
82988F28.desc: Virtual-call thunk: object in r3 -> vtable slot 48 (offset 192) -> bctr. Part of the loading-screen function group used when starting a new game.

8274B748.name: LoadingScreen_Virtual42
8274B748.desc: Virtual-call thunk: object in r3 -> vtable slot 42 (offset 168) -> bctr. Part of the loading-screen function group used when starting a new game.
8274B748.trigger: Loading screen when starting a new game (internal dispatch).

82EAA980.name: LoadingScreen_Virtual36
82EAA980.desc: Null-checked virtual-call thunk: checks r4 for null, swaps args (r4<-r3, r3<-r4), reads vtable slot 36 (offset 144) of the object, and tail-calls it. Part of the new-game loading-screen group.
82EAA980.trigger: Loading screen when starting a new game (internal dispatch).

8274B758.name: LoadingScreen_Virtual39
8274B758.desc: Virtual-call thunk: object in r3 -> vtable slot 39 (offset 156) -> bctr. Part of the loading-screen function group used when starting a new game.
8274B758.trigger: Loading screen when starting a new game (internal dispatch).

8274B778.name: LoadingScreen_Virtual28
8274B778.desc: Virtual-call thunk: object in r3 -> vtable slot 28 (offset 112) -> bctr. Part of the loading-screen function group used when starting a new game.
8274B778.trigger: Loading screen when starting a new game (internal dispatch).

822D6678.name: LoadingScreen_VectorOffset
822D6678.role: loading-screen vector offset add (tails to sub_822AADE0)
822D6678.desc: Loads a 128-bit vector constant from a data table (lis r11,-31926; addi r10,r11,-21152; lvx128), adds it to the in-flight float vectors v1/v2 (vaddfp), then tails into sub_822AADE0. Applies a fixed positional offset, part of the new-game loading-screen group.
822D6678.trigger: Loading screen when starting a new game (internal helper).

822142D0.name: GetNewGameLoadingGlobal
822142D0.role: returns the new-game loading-screen global pointer
822142D0.desc: Const thunk: builds the data address 0x8331950C (lis r11,-31950; lwz r3,-27380(r11)) and returns the pointer stored there in r3. Head of the 'loading screen when starting a new game' group.
822142D0.trigger: Loading screen when starting a new game (internal getter).
